verdict.rationale: Windows does expose programmatic surfaces: an official PowerShell scripting CLI and developer APIs (Windows App SDK, Win32/C++/WinRT, Windows AI APIs). However, nothing in the evidence shows that these cover everything the UI can do, so API/UI parity is only implied, not demonstrated. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, evidence that settings and features like Snap layouts, Copilot, Live Captions and Windows Hello are scriptable, and independent hands-on corroboration of full automation coverage.
